component.name: Barebuh Music Player
component.summary: Music player and collection organizer with federated internet radio

description.p: Barebuh plays and organizes local music and discovers internet-radio stations through an open, signed federation protocol.

Barebuh is an independent modified fork of Strawberry Music Player, which was derived from Clementine. It retains upstream attribution and is distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
This development metadata intentionally contains no homepage, bug tracker, donation, screenshot, update, or release URL until Barebuh-owned endpoints are approved.
Unsigned local development candidate based on Strawberry 1.2.30.
